definitions.full: H8657. Teresh תֶּ֫רֶשׁ proper name, masculine eunuch at court of Ahasuerus (Scheft 58 compare Old Iranian tarša , 'Begierde,' used as proper name in New Persian); — Est 2:21 ; 6:2 ; Θαρ ( ρ ) ας .

occurrences.englishText: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.
It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.
